steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cough, cough... Where are we now?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, Hecate... Where are you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is... Keylan Square. Zoya's Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why am I back here again?
She stumbles a step backward fearfully.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, Hecate! Where are you?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!!
Seeing the person she's looking for, Hella is just about to run forward, but the person suddenly growls. Hella halts her steps reflexively.
${PlayerName} raises a hand and keeps punching the person beneath hysterically, one blow after another, as if assaulting an inanimate object.
The usual calmness and kindness are completely gone from ${PlayerName}'s eyes, only fury and violence are left. This unfamiliar and terrifying look is exactly like one of those mad Maniacs.
No, even scarier than them.

steps.speaker: Frenzied Figure
steps.content: You've turned her into a monster!
A punch, then another.

steps.speaker: Frenzied Figure
steps.content: You've twisted everything, you've poisoned Syndicate, you've driven her to this!
036 is being punched like a broken string puppet, blood streaming down onto the filthy ground. Slowly, his voice fades from Hella's ears, and his form becomes indistinguishable in her eyes.

The body is twisted and deformed. Fresh bloodstains cover the spotty ground. Despair and screams are excellent seasoning for the bloodthirsty, fueling the furious monster who is ripping everything apart...
She's seen scenes like this, in that dim lab, in her most detested memories. Hella feels that something is crumbling within her too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=24>Stop... Stop...</size>

steps.speaker: Frenzied Figure
steps.content: Die!!
036 has been impaled, once again, right before Hella. ${PlayerName} lower his hands. The shackles in his palms have gone out of control, just like red maniac filth.
steps.female_content: 036 has been impaled, once again, right before Hella. ${PlayerName} lower her hands. The shackles in her palms have gone out of control, just like red maniac filth.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}! Stop!
She wants to go forward, but someone suddenly drags her back.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Stay back!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-nine, why are you here?!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Because you're in danger, you need me.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Don't go near him, that's a monster, he'll hurt you. Follow me!
steps.female_content: Don't go near her, that's a monster, she'll hurt you. Follow me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName} is not a monster! He's said it before, none of us are monsters! He's not gonna hurt me!
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} is not a monster! She's said it before, none of us are monsters! She's not gonna hurt me!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Then why are you so scared?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm... scared?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...It's not like that. I've just... never seen him like this.
steps.female_content: ...It's not like that. I've just... never seen her like this.

steps.content: Hella turns toward the person at the distant spot, but he's already come close when she wasn't aware, so close that she can see blood streaming down his face. It's a stranger's face.
steps.female_content: Hella turns toward the person at the distant spot, but she's already come close when she wasn't aware, so close that she can see blood streaming down her face. It's a stranger's face.

steps.speaker: Frenzied Figure
steps.content: ...Hella?
There's no warmth in ${PlayerName}'s eyes. He reaches out a hand to Hella.
steps.female_content: There's no warmth in ${PlayerName}'s eyes. She reaches out a hand to Hella.

steps.content: At that instant, Hella's heart is grabbed by an invisible hand, and her cold body no longer belongs to her.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No matter how much you treasure him, you can't lie to yourself. You fear this man.
steps.female_content: No matter how much you treasure her, you can't lie to yourself. You fear this woman.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella, humans can never overcome their fear.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: Back to the parade

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: <size=44>Hamel! Hamel! The performance is about to begin! Hamel!</size>
The marching crowd is no longer paying any attention to you who stick out like a sore thumb. They're singing and moving forward, pushing you on and separating Hella who's still in a trance from you.
You squeeze your way forward with all your might, trying to grab her, but the reveling crowd is blocking your way.

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: No more fear, no more need to escape, no more nightmares...
